option_relations.rationale: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma is a subtype of thyroid cancer that can metastasize, aligning with the broader concept of Vascularized Thyroid Cancer Metastasis.
The option 'Metastatic Vascular Thyroid Carcinoma' is directly equivalent to the leaf 'Vascularized Thyroid Cancer Metastasis'.
Radioiodine-refractory vesicular thyroid carcinoma (VTC) with sinonasal metastasis is a specific type of metastatic thyroid cancer, making it a subtype of Vascularized Thyroid Cancer Metastasis.
Metastatic Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma is a subtype of thyroid cancer that can metastasize, aligning with the broader concept of Vascularized Thyroid Cancer Metastasis.
